comments.body:
Required discovery: The Statue of Osiris
Crafted in: Malaga (65k ducats)

Part of the Personification of Gods Memorial Album; it will also be used as a base item to craft the Set figurehead beginning with the first chapter of Seven Wonders. See detail on its page.
